title: four providers give the body iterator a fresh first-event budget, so the lane's single wire-to-first-event budget explanation is false
trigger: `watchdog-ceilings.test.ts` parks for 20,000 ms with a 1,000 ms first-event budget, then delivers headers after 600 ms and no body event.
measured:
- Bedrock, Google, Vertex Gemini, and Ollama abort at 1,000 ms after the wire.
- Anthropic, OpenAI completions, OpenAI responses, and Azure do not abort at 1,000 ms; first abort occurs at 1,600 ms. Each clears the pre-response guard at headers and gives its body iterator a fresh full first-event budget. All eventually time out; no never-ending provider stream was observed in this matrix.
- An anchored previous-head comparison reproduces 1,600 ms for OpenAI completions, responses, and Azure.
